level_1_raw.name: Level 1: The Raw Model
level_1_raw.description: Agent = Model + Harness. With no harness, the runner cannot reliably terminate on real conditions — expect hallucinated tools, corrosion, and abandoned tasks.
level_1_raw.tutorial: Proposition: Agent = Model + Harness. A model alone is not an agent — without harness infrastructure it cannot ground tools, persist work, or stop on real evidence.

level_2_harness.name: Level 2: Harness Engineering
level_2_harness.description: Same model, different harness — results diverge sharply. Unlock all six harness dimensions. Still no loop, so a single failed test abandons the task.
level_2_harness.tutorial: Proposition: Same model, different harness → huge difference. Context injection, tool surface, persistence, budget guard, sandbox, and tracing change outcomes far more than swapping the model.

level_3_loop.name: Level 3: Loop Engineering
level_3_loop.description: Loop on evidence, not confidence. Configure trigger, goal, state/action policy, evidence, feedback, and stop rules. Loop engineering ≠ prompt engineering.
level_3_loop.tutorial: Proposition: Evidence, not confidence. Loop ≠ prompt engineering — stop on real checks (tests, schema, review), not "agent says done."

level_4_graph.name: Level 4: Graph Engineering
level_4_graph.description: The graph decides who runs next — not what the agent does. Use conditional edges, state schema, and checkpointing. Simple single-agent tasks need no graph.
level_4_graph.tutorial: Proposition: Graph = who runs next — not a knowledge graph. Conditional edges route control flow. A simple single-agent task often needs no graph at all.

harness.title: Harness Configuration
harness.contextInjectionDesc: Ground the model with retrieved files, specs, and prior run state
harness.toolSurfaceDesc: Expose a real, typed tool API so the model cannot invent tools
harness.persistenceDesc: Commit workspace changes so edits do not overwrite each other
harness.budgetGuardDesc: Cap spend and stop the run before tokens explode
harness.sandboxIsolationDesc: Execute code in an isolated environment that cannot corrupt the host
harness.tracingDesc: Record every step so failures are diagnosable, not mysterious

loop.title: Loop Anatomy
loop.enabledDesc: Allow the agent to iterate until evidence or budget says stop

reflections.reflect_test_fail: Last run failed an assertion. This time, read the full error before editing.
reflections.reflect_wrong_file: Last run edited the wrong file. This time, follow the stack trace to the real path.
reflections.reflect_off_by_one: Last run had an off-by-one boundary bug. This time, check loop and index bounds.
reflections.reflect_dependency: Last run missed a dependency import. This time, confirm the module is in scope.

failureHints.HALLUCINATED_TOOL: The agent called a tool that does not exist. Without a real tool surface (and usually sandbox isolation), the model invents APIs.
failureHints.FILE_CORROSION: The agent overwrote its own work. Without persistence, each edit destroyed the previous one.
failureHints.MEMORY_STACK_OVERFLOW: The agent ran out of memory buffer. Too many steps without enough capacity and it forgot the task.
failureHints.CONTEXT_FULL: The context window filled during retries. History accumulated until the agent could no longer process new information.
failureHints.INFINITE_LOOP_TRAP: The agent looped without progress: fail → same action → fail. Stop rules or iteration caps were missing or too weak.
failureHints.TASK_ABANDONED: The agent quit after the first failure. With no loop enabled, a single test fail ended the run.
failureHints.BUDGET_EXHAUSTED: The run hit the token budget cap. Budget guard stopped the agent before it could finish.
failureHints.UNGROUNDED_STOP: The agent stopped because it "said done" — not because evidence passed. Ungrounded stop conditions lie.

failureFixes.HALLUCINATED_TOOL: Enable Tool Surface and Sandbox Isolation in Harness.
failureFixes.FILE_CORROSION: Enable Persistence in Harness so edits are versioned.
failureFixes.MEMORY_STACK_OVERFLOW: Raise Memory Capacity, or add Context Injection / Tracing to manage state.
failureFixes.CONTEXT_FULL: Raise Memory Capacity, tighten state_policy, or split work with a Graph.
failureFixes.INFINITE_LOOP_TRAP: Set stop_on to evidence_pass (or budget_or_max) and raise max_iterations if needed.
failureFixes.TASK_ABANDONED: Enable the Loop and set evidence + stop_on so the agent can recover.
failureFixes.BUDGET_EXHAUSTED: Raise token_budget_cap, or reduce max_iterations / tighten the loop.
failureFixes.UNGROUNDED_STOP: Change stop_on from agent_says_done to evidence_pass, and set evidence to a real check.
